label: Strict fact priority at a world: asymmetry and separately stated transitivity
term: strict explanatory priority of facts at one world
definition: FactPriorityAsymmetricAt A w requires that an admitted explanation from p to q never reverses. FactPriorityTransitiveAt A w separately requires composition of two edges in that SAME Arena.explains relation at w. The underlying explains relation is primitive (PSR comparison arena); these are explicit constraints on a selected strict-priority interpretation. Neither is inferred from efficient causation, reference, truthmaking, or a mixture of such relations. Examples are a mode specification prior to an exercise and that exercise prior to its effect; a symmetric equivalence or an explanatory restatement is not strict priority.
note: Analyst formulation. Transitivity and asymmetry have independent deductive roles; irreflexivity plus transitivity would suffice for the cycle argument. The frozen application retains asymmetry to express its selected strict-priority interpretation. Applicability, factivity and completeness are not built into either predicate.
